identity.title: ALMA observations of transient heating in a solar active region

paper_type_evidence.quote: We examined 3 mm signatures of heating events identified in Solar Dynamics Observatory (SDO) observations of an active region and compared the results with synthetic spectra from a 3D radiative magnetohydrodynamic simulation.

limitations_admitted.value: Simulation magnetic topology not comparable to the observed region; no IRIS data; DEM coronal estimates are lower limits

evidence.quote: Furthermore, the magnetic topology is not directly comparable to the observed active region

referee_caveats_inferred: Single snapshot simulation compared to a long observed series
Absolute Tb offset from single-dish adds systematic uncertainty
Co-alignment of ALMA/SDO refined by eye on the features studied, risking circularity
Nanoflare energies depend on assumed density and geometry
